issue_title: [Bug] Todo constructor accepts empty text without validation, inconsistent with rename
fix_summary: Added text validation in Todo.__post_init__ to reject empty or whitespace-only text, consistent with rename() method behavior. Also strips leading/trailing whitespace from valid text.
acceptance_criteria_met: Todo(id=1, text='') raises ValueError with message containing 'cannot be empty'
risks: Minimal risk - the change adds validation that was missing. Any code that previously created Todos with empty text will now raise ValueError, which is the intended behavior.
limitations: None - the fix is minimal and complete.
